transcript: Speaker A (Female Voiceover): एक सेंटेंस इंग्लिश का ढंग से नहीं बोल पाती, नौकरी कैसे मिली? यह वॉशरूम में मेरी कलीग ने कहा, मेरे बारे में। सच था, मुझे इंग्लिश बोलनी नहीं आती थी... [I couldn't speak a single sentence of English properly, how did I get the job? My colleague said this about me in the washroom. It was true, I didn't know how to speak English...] Speaker B (Female Colleague 1): यार पता नहीं इसको जॉब कैसे मिली। एक सेंटेंस इंग्लिश का ढंग से बोल नहीं पाती। [Friend, I don't know how she got this job. She can't even speak one sentence of English properly.] Speaker C (Female Colleague 2): पता नहीं कहां-कहां से आ जाते हैं गांव की गंवार कहीं की। [Don't know where they come from, village illiterate.] Speaker A: वह बात मेरे कानों में तीर की तरह लगी... मैंने डिसाइड किया कि अब बहाने नहीं बनाऊंगी... फिर यूट्यूब पर 'English Seekho' ऐप का वीडियो देखा... एआई कोच दिशा से मैंने अपने कमरे में अकेले बिना किसी डर के बोल के प्रैक्टिस की... [Those words hit me like an arrow... I decided not to make excuses... then saw the 'English Seekho' app on YouTube... practiced speaking fearlessly with AI Coach Disha in my room...] Speaker A (speaking English): I have reviewed the project details. I think you've put the wrong number here. Please check it again. Speaker A: ...मैंने अपनी इज्जत वापस कमा ली थी। अगर तुम भी सिर्फ इंग्लिश की वजह से पीछे रह रहे हो, तो English Seekho डाउनलोड करो। [...I earned my respect back. If you are also held back by English, download English Seekho.] Speaker D (Female Outro Voiceover): Install Now पर क्लिक करो और अभी English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Click on Install Now and download the English Seekho app now.]
on_screen_text: ek sentence english ka dhang se nahin bol pati. naukri kaise mili? mere baare mein sach tha... degree se jyada aapki english mayne rakhti hai... English Seekho. Install Now. [Not able to speak one sentence of English properly. How did she get the job? It was true about me... English matters more than your degree... English Seekho. Install Now.]
summary: An animated narrative of a small-town girl working in a big city who faces embarrassment and mockery at her office due to her poor English speaking skills. After failing to learn from expensive offline classes and grammar books, she discovers the English Seekho app. Using its interactive AI coach, she gains the confidence to speak fluent English, regains her self-respect, and encourages viewers to download the app.
